title: Separate Correlation from General Association
text: A correlation of $$0$$ rules out a linear association, but the scatterplot could still show a nonlinear pattern.

title: Connect Correlation to the OLS Slope
text: In simple linear regression with an intercept, the optimal slope is proportional to the correlation: $$\theta_1$$ $$=$$ corr(temperature, tip) * SD(tip) / SD(temperature).

title: Check the Intercept Separately
text: With slope $$0$$, the intercept equals the mean tip, not $$0$$. Since all tips are greater than $1, the intercept statement is false while the slope statement is true.
